title: RunRequest
description: v1 (v6 delta) — inbound control: main server (or any scheduler) → airlock, HMAC-signed, POSTed to /run. Wakes the daemon for one source + reference month. Every field is validated against the airlock's config: source/series must be allowlisted, model must be in the config allowlist, and budget is clamped to the config ceiling. A RunRequest can SELECT WITHIN the airlock's capabilities but can never EXPAND them. Replaces cron as the wake mechanism — Railway cron, a Windows Task Scheduler task, or the airlock's own --schedule loop all just POST one of these.

requestId.description: rr-<uuid v4>. Correlates logs across the scheduler → airlock → broadcast chain.

source.description: The single source this wake handles. Must exist in the airlock's [sources] config.

targets.description: Which forecast target(s) this wake contributes to. The airlock uses the first as the stored dataset's target in Phase 1.5.

series.description: Optional subset of series to fetch for this source. Omit to let the airlock use its configured default set for the source. Every entry must be an allowlisted seriesId whose configured source == this request's source.

model.description: Optional OpenRouter model id (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o-mini'). Must be in the airlock's [models] allowlist. Omit to use the configured default. The cost ceiling always stays in Rust.

budget.description: Requested budget. The airlock CLAMPS each field down to its config ceiling — a request can ask for less, never more.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical request body (every field above except `signature`, serialized in schema order), keyed by the shared secret. Authenticates the scheduler/main-server to the airlock. Verified before ANY field is trusted.
